title: AI promises productivity, but for managers, it’s mostly a headache for now
hook_text: Over fifty percent of managers struggle with AI
script:
More than fifty percent of managers now find evaluating work harder after adopting AI.
A TechCrunch survey published in October 2026 revealed that workplace tools create major oversight headaches.
Employees rely on automated software to draft reports and write code every day.
Bosses struggle to verify who actually wrote the code or built the final presentation.
Can you accurately measure output when algorithms do half the heavy lifting?
